finding_closure.evidence: Można powiedzieć po prostu: „Dzięki, to mi naprawdę pomogło”. A można najpierw posłuchać, co zauważyli inni.
finding_closure.assessment: The defensive mandatory-thanks disclaimer is gone. The normal thank-you and option to listen carry the low-pressure tone directly.

neighbor_and_dependency_review: The revised PL02 habit example concerns a shared expression and tone rather than a person denying a saying. It invites recognition without an accusation.
The deleted charades closing no longer casts a family member as the one who complicates or defends the game. Shared activity humour remains in the source-backed example.

Five minutes, two people, joining a preferred part and skipping a day remain clear. No catch-up obligation, forced vulnerability, preschool voice, developmental claim or prediction of better child behaviour appears.
PL01 remains a practical family-time article; PL02 remains an activity-calendar article about preparation and participation. Neither requires an ideal family evening.
overall_assessment: Adult parent/family audience fit passes. Warm and engaging without guilt or manufactured emotional outcomes. No unresolved audience finding in the reviewed final scope.
